name: bert-extractive-summarization
description: MobileBERT and DistilBERT for extractive summarization

paragraphs: In an effort to make BERTSUM (Liu et al., 2019) lighter and faster for low-resource devices, I fine-tuned DistilBERT (Sanh et al., 2019) and MobileBERT (Sun et al., 2019), two lite versions of BERT on CNN/DailyMail dataset. DistilBERT has the same performance as BERT-base while being 45% smaller. MobileBERT is 4x smaller and 2.7x faster than BERT-base yet retains 94% of its performance.

I modified the source codes in PreSumm to use the HuggingFace's transformers library and their pretrained DistilBERT model. At the moment (05/31/2020), MobileBERT is not yet available in transformers. Fortunately, I found this PyTorch implementation of MobileBERT by @lonePatient.
Please visit PreSumm for instructions for training on CNN/DailyMail and this modified repo forked from PreSumm for fine-tuning DistilBERT and MobileBERT.
